// J1939_EEC1: CAN ID 0x0CF00400 (extended), 8 bytes, sender ECM
// J1939 PGN 61444 (0xF004) EEC1 — Electronic Engine Controller 1, priority 3, PDU2 (broadcast), source address 0x00
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// ActualEnginePercentTorque: start bit 16, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset -125, range -125 .. 125 %
ActualEnginePercentTorque_raw = data[2]
ActualEnginePercentTorque = ActualEnginePercentTorque_raw - 125

// EngineSpeedJ1939: start bit 24, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.125, offset 0, range 0 .. 8031.875 rpm
EngineSpeedJ1939_raw = data[3] | (data[4] << 8)
EngineSpeedJ1939 = EngineSpeedJ1939_raw * 0.125
